body_md:
People in the UK enjoy gardening, walking, going to the pub and watching TV. You need a **TV licence** to watch live TV on any device.

Each country has traditional food: roast beef and Yorkshire pudding (England), haggis (Scotland), Welsh cakes (Wales) and the Ulster fry (Northern Ireland).

**National parks** are protected areas of countryside that everyone can visit.
key_facts: TV licence needed for live TV on any device
National parks are open to everyone
